text: No tree-cover loss occurred on this asset after 2020. The asset was 11.55% forest in 2020 (43.3 ha) according to JRC data, and the observation series runs to 2025 without detecting any loss events meeting the 0.5-ha minimum. The full area was valid for analysis, and no post-2020 changes passed the corroboration rule requiring agreement between the JRC 2020 reference and later observations.
